# Read a file containing sequence quality scores

Read a file containing sequence quality scores

## Usage

``` r
read_quality(quality, path = NULL)
```

## Arguments

- quality:

  string, containing the quality score file name.

- path:

  string, optional path to quality score file.

## Value

A data.frame containing the quality score sequence data

## Examples

``` r

quality_data <- strollur::read_quality(strollur_example("tiny.qual"))

# quality_data is a data.frame.
# To access the names of the sequences in the file, run the following:

quality_data$sequence_name
#> [1] "M00967:43:000000000-A3JHG:1:1101:18327:1699"
#> [2] "M00967:43:000000000-A3JHG:1:1101:14069:1827"
#> [3] "M00967:43:000000000-A3JHG:1:1101:18044:1900"

# To access the quality scores in the file, run the following:
```
